title: Migrate biome.json to the installed Biome version
description:
npx biome check . reports 'Run the command biome migrate to migrate the configuration file.' as an info diagnostic on main. Info-level diagnostics do not fail the build (Biome has no exit-on-info flag), so this accumulates silently.

Introduced by the Biome bump in the dev-tooling dependabot group (PR #501, merged as 0a44cde). Observed 2026-08-28 while working eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1.1.

Fix: npx biome migrate --write, then confirm npm run check is clean including frozen paths.

AGENTS.md 'Formatting & Linting' requires keeping biome.json migrated to the installed Biome precisely so info noise does not accumulate. Kept out of the eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1.1 PR because AGENTS.md requires dependency/toolchain work to stay separate from feature and importer changes.
